messages.subject: For Jamie Beck | Responsible mining, stakeholder strategy and Ecuador execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Creaney,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Jamie Beck, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Lundin Gold's operating success in Ecuador depends on disciplined coordination across government, communities, sustainability commitments and mine operations. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage senior institutional engagement, coordinate complex regulatory and stakeholder matters across operating functions, and translate external commitments into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support Lundin Gold's government-relations, social-performance, sustainability or country-level priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Lundin Gold.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
